blocks.text: The Philippines’ Bea Millan-Windorski gave centerstage treatment to the rich culture of the Cordilleras during the 2026 Miss Universe national costume competition, in which she drew the world’s attention to the water shortage crisis in the country amid the looming El Niño phenomenon. Wearing “Diwa ng Kordilyera,” a creation by designer Anthony Ramirez, the Filipino-American activist paraded on stage the Coliseo de Puerto Rico Jose Miguel Agrelot in San Juan on Nov. 21 (22 in Manila). The stunning piece is an ode to the culture of the highlands of northern Philippines. The ensemble features the unique tattoo patterns of Kalinga, the […]...
